fieldValues.title: A slice of a clean repository can warn about a lifecycle relation it cut
fieldValues.summary: A record in state superseded needs an incoming supersedes relation; when the slice cuts that relation into externalRelationRefs, the slice reports LIFECYCLE_RELATION_UNSATISFIED as a warning that the origin repository does not have.
evidence: muSrs essay slice, 2026-11-27: warning on record 49c88628; origin repository has no such warning
RFC-026 [R17] lists four info-level slice absences; this is not one of them, so it keeps warning severity
fieldValues.body: A lifecycle relation rule could be satisfied by an externalRelationRefs entry of the right type, or the case added to the [R17] info list.
